modeled_contact_caveat: The combined policy assigns pad or finger contact before checking each pose. Each tile shows its selected mode. Pad means the original saved pad surfaces; finger means the original inward convex finger collision surfaces. The detailed visual finger has a groove bridged by that coarse collision hull. These are modeled contacts; physical contact accuracy and pickup or assembly success have not been verified.
